answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a pigment bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the beacon schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
